structured.rankingRationale: Top priority is the combination of official/edition-specific resort commitment, exact future dates, and explicit lodging or group mechanism. CICI, SLAP, Wheat Growers and FEDOPACC provide the clearest conference lodging signals; WSOP provides a strong resort-hosted competition signal; CMI provides official-hotel institutional programming; Travel With Class provides an explicit group-rate/held-block mechanism. All are ranked below accessible open-sourcing opportunities because the current edition is committed elsewhere.

rejectedOrFlagged.label: IOC Session Punta Cana 2027
rejectedOrFlagged.reason: Edition-specific reporting names Barceló Bávaro and Lopesan Costa Bávaro in a proposal, but the cited evidence does not establish a committed official resort host or hotel contract; monitor, do not accept as committed competitor business.

rejectedOrFlagged.label: ATECAM Destination Conference 2027
rejectedOrFlagged.reason: Future event and group room block are evidenced, but the named hotel is Iberostar Waves Punta Cana, outside the supplied competitor list.

notesForDeepResearch: Prioritize organizer/PCO and housing-agency mapping, overflow evidence, and future-edition rotation/RFP timing.
Do not use the competitor commitment as proof of target-hotel availability or assume room blocks are transferable.
materialUncertainties: All seven candidates are future events with named competing resorts; none should be treated as open current-edition inventory for Wyndham Alltra.
Published attendance and peak-room figures were not found for these candidates, so those fields are null.
The named organizer contacts are discovery leads only; contracting authority is not verified.

result.text: Structured discovery of seven future Punta Cana event opportunities with edition-specific competitor-resort commitments, plus two flagged exclusions. Current-edition competitor commitments are treated as venue constraints rather than open inventory.
